title: @ file autocomplete in the Claude pane's box
notes: Claude Code: typing @ shows fuzzy path suggestions. SDK: file_suggestions control request (sdk.d.ts:4039) is a non-exported type with no Query method, unverified; fallback is listing files ourselves with the repo's fuzzy.ts. Pane: the menu opens only for /, chat-commands.ts:57; @ comes only from drag and drop. Size M.

comments.body: PR #103: @ opens a fuzzy list of git's files (tracked + untracked-not-ignored) over the box; Tab/Enter inserts the mention. SDK file_suggestions has no Query method, so files are listed via git ls-files. Folders not offered.
Shipped in PR #103: @ opens a list of the project's files in the Claude pane's box, narrowing as you type; Tab or Enter puts the pick in as an @ mention. Version 2.10.0.
